Comprehensive support for your hygiene process

Hygiene in the food industry is of great importance. Yet many organizations lack real-time insight into hygiene data, malfunctions and process progress. Elpress’ eCloud changes that. This smart, certified cloud platform gives you 24/7 real-time insight into your hygiene systems.

Service is our watchword. Even after you have invested in our products, we continue to work with you. For maintenance and/or repairs, we have the necessary equipment and expertise on board our service vans, which are out on the road every day.

Although our product ranges have been developed specifically for the market, Elpress does occasionally receive requests for bespoke solutions. We have over 50 years’ experience in industrial hygiene and are therefore well versed in bespoke projects.

As a pioneering leader in hygiene solutions, we strive to innovate continuously and raise the bar in our industry. We can only achieve this by bringing together a team of driven individuals who are passionate about delivering high-quality products and outstanding services.
Our strength lies in the fact that we are a full-service provider—a single partner for all your hygiene needs.

Our Employees | Elpress

Health and safety are top priorities at Elpress. The VCA certification underscores this. All Elpress employees involved in hands-on work have completed basic safety training so that everyone is aware of potential (hidden) health and safety risks in the workplace.
Corporate social responsibility is very important to Elpress. Through our sustainable approach we make our company future-proof. We consciously deal with energy and we invest in our employees.

As part of our commitment to our people and the environment, Elpress BV conducts a comprehensive annual evaluation of its sustainability initiatives through EcoVadis, the globally recognized authority on business sustainability assessments. The EcoVadis appraisal encompasses
At Elpress, sustainable entrepreneurship has also been integrated into personnel policy. In this way, we work on the employability, loyalty, vitality and commitment of our employees.

Elpress employees are given the opportunity to follow courses and trainings. This can be general training such as VCA and BHV, obtaining a forklift truck certificate, learning an (extra) language or subject-specific and deepening studies.
We care about the hapiness of our employees. There is an informal atmosphere and the combination of a top-down and bottom-up strategy gives our employees the opportunity to think along with us.

Healthy workplaces with a sit/stand option and offering fresh fruit contributes to the health of our employees. At Elpress, we believe it is important that our employees remain healthy and vital. In case of health problems Elpress provides a direct and short communication line with physiotherapists and company doctors.

All packaging of Elpress products have the FSC label. FRC stands for the Forest Stewardship Council and is an international organisation that works on preserving and maintaining forests worldwide. In this way, Elpress takes account of the ecological, social and economical aspects that form part of forestry management.
4 years warranty on sole brushes

Being a total supplier is what makes Elpress so strong. Apart from manufacturing and supplying our innovative products, we also focus on delivering excellent service. Which is why we offer 4-year full warranty on sole brushes. Providing this service lets us ensure that we can increase food safety together.

A hygiene entrance is a means for ensuring the personal hygiene of employees and visitors of companies. The hygiene entrance is usually installed at the entrance to a company so that hygiene requirements can always be complied with before somebody enters the shop floor.
In most instances, the hygiene entrance has an access control feature to ensure that employees clean and disinfect their hands before they enter the production area.
Shoe soles carry visible and invisible dirt on them. It is therefore important to clean the soles before entering the production area.

A turnstile ensures that a hygiene check takes place before the employees enter the production area. Checks cover the washing and disinfecting of both hands, the length of the contact time, the use of chemicals and any person and time recording. An access check offers you many advantages.

Elpress sinks are the answer for your company when it comes to personal hygiene in the food industry. Given the many points of contact between employees, food and machines, we at Elpress are highly aware of the fact that personal hygiene and hand hygiene within the food industry are extremely important.
